summary.text: Christopher Kibbey is the Republican candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary.
He ran for the same district in 2024 and lost the general election.

paragraphs.text: In the November 5, 2024 general election for Arizona House District 21, Kibbey received 27.1 percent of the vote (33,883 votes), finishing behind Democratic incumbents Consuelo Hernandez and Stephanie Stahl Hamilton.
